notes.epoch_context: Epoch 1794441600 opened 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z (boundary block 56256122, ts 1794441600). Votes were cast during epoch 1793836800. All three boundary phases landed on-chain: run 212 (phase 1, k=7, block 56255083, T-208s), run 213 (phase 2, k=7, block 56255923, T-40s), run 214 (phase 3, k=7, block 56256047, T-15s, send-time expected $1,243.63), which is the binding allocation; lastVoted 1794441585 equals its block time. Receipts: status 1 with 60, 42 and 42 logs. This was the first boundary night with the phase-outcome change (PR #24); the monitor reported all three phases as completed, matching the chain. The backup vote, run 211 (2026-11-11T15:09Z, k=13, expected $3,489.19), was replaced; its expectation again came from bribes other voters had not yet piled into.

notes.headline: Realised $1,245.75 ($0.6868 per 1k votes against $0.7019 last epoch). Against run 214's realized-at-boundary entitlement of $1,245.57 it is +$0.18; all 11 tokens reconcile on amount (ratios 0.99998-1.00002 from UI rounding), and the USD difference is price movement since the boundary snapshot.
notes.opportunity_gap: Boundary optimum $1,266.98 at k=29 against run 214's realized-at-boundary $1,245.57: an executed gap of $21.41 (1.69%), against 3.56% last epoch. Run 214's send-time expectation of $1,243.63 rose $1.93 by the boundary. Denylist cost $0.00. Price basis is phase 1's snapshot (ts 1794441366, ~4 min before the boundary).
notes.price_feed: The routing-divergence audit found no unhandled persistent overprice. The backup vote's dry run swapped three routing quotes for CoinGecko reference prices via the 3x sanity check; the router's batch quote failed 10 times and fell back to per-token quotes, in line with recent weeks (5-8).
notes.claim_swap_outcome: Claimed and swapped 2026-11-12. 46 of 46 escrow claim batches successful (--claim-source escrow, 23 gauges: the union of the backup vote and all three phases), no retries. Transfers to the wallet summed from the 46 receipts match the table for all 11 tokens (USDC 1,235.628879 against 1,235.6335 displayed): gross received $1,245.75. The router-batch swap delivered 9.928043 USDC for 6 legs (FACY, AVNT, frxUSD, wtMCD, WETH, CADD) marked at $9.92 (+0.10%). frxUSD and CADD included about 0.65 and 0.59 left over from earlier weeks, which lifted them over the $1 dust threshold. This epoch's BRZ, WFRAX, KRWQ and wtTR stayed below the threshold and were left unswapped (about $1.52). End state 1,245.556922 USDC = 1,235.628879 claimed + 9.928043 swapped. Gas 0.000238 ETH: 0.000224 claims, 0.000014 approvals and executeSwaps.
